sources.title: Ultra-FineWeb · Datasets
sources.snippet: Ultra-FineWeb contains approximately 1 trillion (T) English tokens and 120 billion (B) Chinese tokens. Empirical results demonstrate that the LLMs trained on Ultra-FineWeb exhibit significant performance improvements across multiple benchmark tasks, validating the effectiveness of our pipeline in enhancing both data quality and training efficiency.

sources.snippet: Once a model has been pre-trained on a next-token prediction task, Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is used to turn it into an assistant capable of answering questions and following instructions. During SFT, models learn a chat template and are specialized in one or more domains.
